Il était hors de question de faire un voyage organisé en groupe avec d’autres touristes inconnus (l’industrie totale). Du coup Hamid, nous a proposé un voyage privatisé: location d un 4X4 très correct + chauffeur-guide. Les chambres, nuits d’hotel, repas du soir étaient organisés et inclus dans le prix de l’excursion. Mise à part la première nuit au « vieux château du Dades » quelque peu inconfortable et pas très appétissante (mais cadre sublime), le reste était absolument topissime. Il faut absolument sortir des grandes villes pour découvrir le Maroc. La nuit dans le désert (type standard) était magnifique... après, nous étions seuls dans le Sahara (énorme chance car bivouac souvent rempli la nuit. Et sentiment de liberté dans ce que nous voulions faire.

Parlant en tout franchise de son pays et de sa culture, nous avons énormément appris! Aussi, une conduite irréprochable sur des routes très correctes! Nous avons été particulièrement impressionnés par l’organisation : tout était parfaitement coordonné, fluide et rassurant du début à la fin. Ce voyage nous a permis de faire de multiples rencontres, toutes enrichissantes et authentiques.

Un immense merci à notre chauffeur Hisham, exceptionnel tout au long du séjour : professionnel, ponctuel, prudent et toujours souriant. Nous nous sommes sentis en totale confiance avec lui. L’hôtel du premier jour était également au top, très confortable et bien choisi.

Les guides étaient tous adorables, avec une mention toute spéciale pour Jamal, notre guide dans les gorges de Dades : un homme passionné, chaleureux et profondément attaché à sa région. Un vrai plaisir de partager ce moment avec lui.

Les déjeuners étaient corrects sans être exceptionnels. Comme ils se déroulaient sur des aires de pause en bord de route, il est compréhensible de ne pas s’attendre à une prestation gastronomique.

Concernant la nuit dans le désert, le cadre était absolument magnifique et l’expérience reste unique. Le camp où nous avons dormi est bien organisé, mais l’accueil nous a semblé plus froid que lors des autres étapes du circuit. L’ensemble est très rodé, ce qui donne parfois une impression assez commerciale. Le petit spectacle du soir était très simple, voire un peu limité.

Au petit matin, nous avons été conduits vers un véritable camp de nomades du désert. Il y avait bien des personnes qui y vivaient, mais le moment nous a paru assez rapide et peu interactif. Nous nous sommes levés à 5h pour admirer le lever du soleil ; malheureusement, la météo n’était pas idéale et le spectacle n’a pas été aussi impressionnant que nous l’espérions.

Tuvimos unos excelentes 3 días junto con Ayub, que nos paseó por muchísimos lugares, con destino al desierto de Merzouga.

Sin dudas todo estuvo espectacular. Desde el trato con él, la seguridad durante todo el viaje, las charlas y los hoteles elegidos para pasar las dos noches que duró nuestro viaje.

El hotel en el valle de Dades fue excelente. La comida muy buena y la atención también. Pero la corona se la lleva sin dudas el campamento en el desierto. Una experiencia de lujo.

El costo del servicio en general termina justificándose por el altísimo nivel que tiene. Sin dudas recomiendo pagar la diferencia por un tour privado como este. Vamos a volver muchas veces más y siempre Ayub va a ser nuestro guía de ahora en más.

Gracias por todo.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhB9bOvR0r7Z4QFCWAUD-EyA&fid=0x0:0xcbe0a56b52dd14eb"],"When":"2026-1-15"},{"Name":"Carmina Correa","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX_YyleJaOKzHgIK_5C2Mn8tTScHkSo4JvY_RXdle7-p4z07XMI=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Recomendadísimo organizar un viaje con esta agencia. La excursión que hemos hecho nosotros con Ayub tenía una duración de 3 días. El primer día recorrimos las montañas Atlas, visitamos la Ksar de Ait-Ben-Haddou y pasamos la noche en el valle del Dades. El segundo día nos llevó a las gargantas del Todra y luego emprendimos camino hacia Merzouga para pernoctar en un campamento bereber en el desierto de Erg Chebbi. Nosotros elegimos hacer las travesías de ida y vuelta, por las dunas, en quad y nos lo organizó así pero también puedes elegir hacerlas en camello. Destacar que los alojamientos que nos reservó han sido geniales y todo el mundo ha sido muy hospitalario y atento.

Volveríamos a elegir a Ayub para hacer otro viaje y poder seguir conociendo lugares hermosos, personas y comidas.
Nos sentimos como en casa a cada lugar que fuimos, nuestro corazón regresa lleno de buenos momentos.

Muchas gracias❤️☀️🐪

Gracias por todo!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD7d1rM7spwObuBTZcmeyQG&fid=0x0:0xcbe0a56b52dd14eb"],"When":"2026-1-15"},{"Name":"Javier de la Peña","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWSWle7QR-xM3MrqxhVoDFV0QAscZ7Cm_A2VIs7Kw-3XJe72PA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Acabamos de regresar de nuestro viaje organizado por Viajes por Marrakech y la experiencia ha superado todas nuestras expectativas. Recomendaríamos esta agencia al 100% a cualquiera que busque una aventura auténtica y bien organizada en Marruecos.

Desde el primer momento, nos sentimos increíblemente cómodos y cuidados. La organización logística fue impecable, permitiéndonos disfrutar plenamente de cada destino sin preocuparnos por nada.

Le service de transport n'a pas respecté les horaires et les chauffeurs se sont montrés extrêmement impolis, surtout ceux pour Essaouira. L'un d'eux a eu un comportement particulièrement déplacé et au retour, il ne nous a pas déposés à l'endroit convenu. Le minibus était très inconfortable, avec des sièges minuscules, et les places n'étaient pas respectées. Par exemple, si vous sortez pour une pause café de 5 minutes, vous risquez de retrouver votre place occupée par un autre passager à votre retour.
Pour l'expérience à Agafay, bien que le début ait été satisfaisant, le chauffeur, qui devait arriver à 17h, n'est finalement venu qu'à 19h. Cependant, ce chauffeur était sympathique et gentil.
Je déconseille fortement toute activité ou voyage avec cette agence. C'est une véritable arnaque, avec beaucoup de personnel impoli et non serviable. Le voyage à Essaouira, prévu pour 8h45, a commencé par une pression du chauffeur, qui est venu nous chercher à 7h50 sans même s'excuser pour l'avance.
En conclusion, je vous recommande vivement d'éviter cette agence.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Zelie Fleuriet","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWL71rKp0FOjK9qH4vfsMerEHU6r485WsOpVTf-oZOK17WH2os9=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Merci à Amar pour ses conseils!! On a passé 3 super moments! D’abord avec la mongolfiere au lever du soleil, puis une après-midi dromadaire, quad avec un diné spectacle pour finir et enfin une superbe excursion à essaouira!! Les chauffeurs étaient au top avec des bus de qualité et un personnel au petit soins!!Des tarifs très abordables ! Encore merci pour tout!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Morgane Tournier","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKcptbZtp6iw0ZPqYTqSDer8dQYEdsMbAWgL1N4uQVvQ19ORg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Zéro et même moins que zéro !
Le minibus était désastreux : pas de place pour poser ses fesses (même avec de petites fesses), pas de place pour les jambes (même en étant de petite taille), aucun confort sur les sièges, ils étaient même tellement usés qu'on glissait vers l'avant et le chauffeur était un vrai danger publique !! J'ai beaucoup voyagé au Maroc et je n'ai jamais eu aussi peur !
En plus on devait faire une pause à l'aller et au retour car il y 2h30 de route entre Marrakech et Essaouira... A l'aller on a eu une pause de 15min avant d'arriver à destination ! Bonjour l'utilité du truc à part nous faire aller dans une coopérative où tous les autres minibus de touristes allaient aussi... Et au retour, il était tellement pressé de rentrer qu'il nous a fait prendre des risques incroyables en conduisant comme un fou et en s'engueulant avec un autre automobiliste (on a cru qu'ils allaient sortir de la voiture pour se taper dessus)
FUYEZ !!!!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lucile Dupuy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWA3mOXJh8Ps4FaYn-SizBpu2loVcHLVlKlUS7nHwRzd1mA9-0R9A=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Nous avions pris comme activité une journée à la vallée D’Ourika. Personne ne nous à expliqué qu’il fallait prendre des bonnes chaussures (car une randonnée en montagne de 1h est programmée) . Le guide nous conduit à un restaurant vraiment pas bon et cher pour la qualité.
Agence à fuir.
35€ par personne à revoir pour la qualité du service proposé!
Dommage que la note Zéro n’existe pas.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Bastos","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLYnsYnNXCKZVhNq9A7kS4BCLHPowN2X3mPvSkYY7OzCvAuxtg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"POUR TOUS LES VOYAGEURS / AGENCE A FUIR / FRAIS CACHÉS : Excursion à Zagora avec eux. À fuir. Je ne recommande pas du tout. Nous avons payé 65€ par personne mais énormément de frais supplémentaires nous ont été imposés. À chaque arrêt du bus, nous devions suivre le guide, nous ne pouvons pas nous promener nous même et découvrir les endroits seuls (car le véhicule change d’endroit et sans le guide, tu ne sais pas où il est). A la fin de la visite (notamment la visite du village BEN AIT) on nous demande des frais de visite pour le village 30 dirhams (alors que la visite du village est gratuite) et des pourboires pour le guide + on nous « force » à aller dans des restos miteux (notamment car nous ne savons pas ou viens nous chercher le bus) et qui puis-est, hors de prix. Pareil pour le désert, à la fin il faut donner des tips… Lorsque nous en avons donné, l’homme est resté devant nous en nous en demandant (limite en nous exigeant) plus d’argent encore.
Bref, à fuir absolument, je vous conseille de trouver des personnes de confiance et non des agences touristiques comme celle ci.
J’espère que les voyageurs comme moi me lirons. Cordialement,","Images":null,"When":""}]

[{"Name":"Ludmila Hadjar","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKhJR8enxXpv9Ny-F8CtMzqwHq6w_ZtvpHQCa-G2CN1BmXe-w=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"S’il était possible de mettre plus que 5 étoiles, on le ferait sans hésiter !

Nous étions trois à réserver notre circuit avec cette agence, et nous avons eu la chance incroyable d’avoir Mustapha comme chauffeur-guide.
C’est une personne en or, d’une gentillesse rare, calme, attentionné, professionnel et passionné par son métier. Toujours à l’écoute, il a su s’adapter à toutes nos envies, anticiper nos besoins et rendre chaque moment unique.

Nous avons fait un circuit de 3 jours de Marrakech à Merzouga en van, et c’était tout simplement parfait : super propre, hyper confortable, et la conduite de Mustapha était exemplaire, douce, sécurisante et toujours agréable.

Ce voyage restera un souvenir inoubliable.
Grâce à Mustapha, nous avons découvert le Maroc autrement, avec le cœur. Son sens du partage, sa bienveillance et sa disponibilité nous ont profondément touchés.
Nous avons eu non seulement un excellent guide, mais aussi une belle rencontre humaine.

Franchement, Mustapha est exceptionnel, une vraie perle ! 🌟
Si vous cherchez quelqu’un de confiance, passionné et humain, choisissez-le les yeux fermés, vous ne serez pas déçus, bien au contraire.

Encore mille mercis pour tout ce que tu nous as fait vivre 🙏
On reviendra, c’est certain, et ce sera à nouveau avec toi !

We just returned from a 10-day, 9-night tour of Morocco arranged by Said from Morocco Discovery, and it was absolutely perfect! From the moment we landed in Marrakech to our final day in Casablanca, every detail was planned with care and precision.

Our private driver was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the long drives across the Atlas Mountains, Sahara Desert, and Imperial Cities a pleasure. The itinerary was beautifully balanced — from camel rides in Merzouga and stargazing at the desert camp to exploring the blue streets of Chefchaouen and the vibrant medinas of Fez and Marrakech.

The hotels and riads were excellent, each with its own charm. Dar Rihana in Dades Gorges was a standout — elegant, peaceful, and surrounded by incredible scenery.

Morocco Discovery truly exceeded our expectations with their professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail. Morocco is a must-visit, and this agency is the best way to experience it. We would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone planning a trip here!

I highly  recommend Morocco Discovery Tours","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Rina Nijhawan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIyDilLNfwZoIuN5613xkv6GbyNXmVgK0HPZf5dU35dPde-pw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our trip to Morocco was absolutely amazing, thanks to the outstanding service from our travel agent and driver. I highly recommend this team to anyone planning a trip to Morocco — their professionalism, helpfulness, and warm hospitality made all the difference!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Vanita Sehgal","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVflr-EDDcv4hJINI7iuj_rsSamIM40UFwByYfP7j2SMBAFFiU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Review for Our Driver – Morocco Trip

È stata un'esperienza indimenticabile che ci ha permesso di vedere tantissimi posti da nord a sud e conoscere culture diverse. PS: per i pranzi consigliamo di portare le persone in luoghi dove assaggiare dei piatti tradizionali, evitando un menù turistico spesso simile.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC305qYSA&fid=0x0:0x6efd1095c1373a6e"],"When":"2024-11-8"},{"Name":"Heather Forer","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocICl1hU02maScZDHPJtkoO2-173JWRxDoviqncJV-96X9-Rjg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I cannot begin to describe how amazing our tour was with Ali! We traveled with 4 adults and 3 children (ages 12-9) and it was a bit like herding cats to keep us all together & entertained but Ali did it seamlessly. When we wanted to stay a bit longer at a location, he arranged it. When we wanted to make a change to our itinerary, it happened as if by magic.

We did a 12-day tour of Morocco, starting in Marrakech, through the Atlas Mountains to Merzouga and the Sahara Desert Camp (with camel ride - highly recommend & choose the luxury camp) to Fes, Volubilis, Chefchaouen, Rabat, and Casablanca. Marrakech Camel Trips arranged everything for us from airport transfers to the riads we stayed in to the activities we participated in. The restaurants they organized for lunch were (mostly) very delicious and the riads we stayed in each night prepared a traditional (I think) and excellent Moroccan dinner for us.

Ali was incredibly patient and friendly with the children as we had some long days all together in the van & it was quite hot. When tempers flared, he was fantastic at determining what was needed and providing it. He also has an amazing eye for photography. The photo of the kasbah reflected in the water was taken by him!

Ali took us to some cool shops where they did traditional crafts (argan oil, rosewater and rose products, ceramics, leather) and we enjoyed the explanation of how everything is made but we never felt any pressure to make a purchase. That being said, we definitely picked up some argan oil and rosewater, as well as some ceramics & leather slippers. We cherish these daily reminders of the most amazing vacation we have had.

We are already talking about another trip to Morocco and we will definitely book it with Ali and Marrakech Camel Trips!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICxvtOUbA&fid=0x0:0x6efd1095c1373a6e"],"When":"2023-5-18"}]

If you like reading, continue. If not here's the short version, Atman from Eco Desert Morocco tours is AMAZING and knows exactly what he's doing. BOOK HIM FOR YOUR MOROCCO TOUR!!

Please be patient because this is a little long. I'd never had a tour guide on any of my travels, always travel with a friend and just do our own thing. Travelling to Africa, Morocco specifically for the very first time was a bit intimidating. Didn't speak ANY of the many languages you can encounter there. As such I decided the best thing to do would be to get a tour guide. I have NO REGRETS!!
I'd seen a post on Facebook singing praises for a guide from Ecodesert Morocco Tours - Atmane Taghlaoui.
I sent him a DM on Instagram, and he responded promptly sending his website. From there, I told him how many days I had and he created an itinerary, sent it via email. I booked him within the week. There was something about how he replied to me that made me feel safe and like he could be trusted. This was July, fast forward to October 22 when we were to land in Casablanca at 4:15 PM from Lisbon but had a 5 hour delay. I was so worried, didn't know if he would be upset or would leave. I kept in touch with him, and he reassured me "it happens, don't worry I will be here waiting" he said. He was so patient and understanding. We eventually landed at 9:30pm, he was super friendly, even though he'd been at the airport for hours. We had to abandon our tour of Casablanca and continue on to Fes, so he drove the 3 hours that night. We got to our Riad at 3:15 am, after he stopped so we could eat.
Throughout the entire week, he was on time each day. Answered all our questions, took us to places that a tourist wouldn't usually go. Told us what to look out for, just overall good advice on how to be aware of our surroundings. Every place he took us to eat was amazing! If you have specific gifts in mind or just want to do regular shopping he will tell you the best place to get the quality at a good price. It was an absolute pleasure having him as our guide, he's super knowledgeable and very proud and passionate about his people. If you're looking for history on your trip, he won't disappoint. He laughed at our jokes, and car karaoke was too funny! We're already planning our trip for the coast. Anytime I'm in Morocco I will always call on Atman. If you are thinking about visiting Morocco and would benefit from a local's knowledge and guidance then Atman is your guy 1000%! He's like ordering Guess and getting Yves Saint Laurent! Trust me, I absolutely recommend!!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC-3ODcQg&fid=0x0:0xc4d92b1978bccb0b"],"When":"2022-10-29"}]

Passeios pela Medina, os Souks, zona Norte e Sul, e restaurantes como Nomade, Le jardín, Café Argana.
Fiquei num Riad, Riad Dar El Masa, o Yassine é muito amigável e dá excelentes dicas, o sítio é confortável, acolhedor e bem perto da praça Jemaa-el-Fna recomendo vivamente.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICjh57jeg&fid=0x0:0x408acaeb0fec3f7a"],"When":"2024-4-26"},{"Name":"Abbass Batouy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKGle7LMdqOyhXSvLbRlivczdqTwrnSAllDhwVlj4gj7wiemw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"When you're in the beautiful Marrakech, the red city, Medina, you find yourself in the bustling heart of the city, also known as "Djemaa el Fna", where stalls, music, people, and activity come together. There are plenty of must-see places, such as the Ben Youssef Mosque & Madrasa, the Koutoubia Mosque, the Moroccan Hammam, and of course, the Souk.

But even outside the city, there are plenty of things to see, such as a hot air balloon ride from Marrakech over the Atlas Mountains with breakfast, camel rides towards Merzouga, Toubkal, or as we did, a day trip to Ourika. We were professionally guided by our tour leader, who picked us up neatly from our riad in a comfortable car (jeep) equipped with all the amenities. Our tour leader spoke Arabic, French, Spanish, and English, making us feel right at home. Along the way, we stopped at a family in the mountains to have breakfast and relax. Upon arriving in Ourika, we were guided by his colleague to climb the Setti Fatma mountain and enjoy the waterfall, where we drank delicious tea on a terrace. After this extraordinary experience, we were treated to a delicious tajine when we were back down.

A trip never to be forgotten, and definitely recommended, especially for the excellent guidance of the guides!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICjku3wZQ&fid=0x0:0x408acaeb0fec3f7a"],"When":"2024-4-19"},{"Name":"Giulia Abate","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJiGl2K52MPPtKNdW24_9af3nWYad_BiSNKz3FQsBNelDm4SA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"In this riad you feel at home

The location near the Medina allows you to reach any attraction within a few minutes' walk.
Good and fresh breakfast, every day a different speciality to try, with homemade jams and orange juice.
Large rooftop with the possibility of bathing or sunbathing.
Excellent cleanliness, spacious bathroom and very quiet room.
We will definitely return, we felt right at home.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICzm830Vg&fid=0x0:0x408acaeb0fec3f7a"],"When":"2024-6-5"},{"Name":"Lorenzo Ricci Pujol","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJg0ubtOyA82zT2rR_uRQvWXW6Vpij5pGr-QyszW2GqSPjfBg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"El Riad Dar el Masa es muy acogedor y cómodo, destacar las piscinas que van perfectas para refrescar los días calurosos de Marrakech y en especial el trato de los empleados (Yassine) que están siempre dispuestos a ayudar y hacen que la experiencia sea mucho mejor. ¡100% Recomendable!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC7iIyzDw&fid=0x0:0x408acaeb0fec3f7a"],"When":"2024-8-11"}]

(There were 8 other travellers in who joined ) Moustapha,  the guide, was friendly, informative , funny and upfront about each part of the day. We truly loved our tour and the day we spent with him. You know you have an exceptional guide when so many locals light up as they cross paths, greeting him warmly, sharing embraces, and laughing together. Abdul’s deep knowledge, genuine connections, and warmth truly made for a great day.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"George Williams","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKGYbgHzIjPIJ0Y5cNGHsFvCO-dfrMGPMKhoj0r5cLDdwswBA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"If you want to explore Marrakech by yourself, go for it. If you want to EXPERIENCE, and explore Marrakech, book this tour, and request Mohamed. He brought me and my family around old city and through the shops. He was chock full of info, details, stories, etc. and brought us to all of the best places. The attention to detail to provide us with a quality experience was top notch. Just an an example, he knew I wanted a specific soccer jersey, and he would be on the lookout in the shops, looking for the one I wanted and size. He brought us to the right places, showed us the right things, and my family and I have come away from this trip feeling like we got everything  out of the old city. A+, 100%, gold star, whatever your top grade is, Mohammed gets. Book this tour, don’t hesitate.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICXzoPB4wE&fid=0x0:0x77912c98cff1e6e4"],"When":"2024-10-16"},{"Name":"Emma ADKINS","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLeRUeXVMztbdbjmeKt3_YRXceX8xP_sX-3CuFlFbkvB9Fyww=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Thank you so much to Abdul for 2 amazing trips during our holiday. One into the Medina and one to Imlil. We had limited time for both but Abdul made sure we packed a lot into our trips.

I had been nervous travelling as 2 females (myself and my 12 year old daughter) but Abdul put us at ease and we felt safe at all times. He was also very knowledgeable and managed to keep my daughter engaged and interested in everything we saw.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC-gq-LEg&fid=0x0:0x77912c98cff1e6e4"],"When":"2022-10-30"},{"Name":"Don Hastings","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXLw3L-0NZ9ZNio_VmoaKvEjMVVzJuszg83nPtnA2PBu5FxZh56=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Arriving in Marrakesh for the first time, it is so tempting to go on a buying spree as there are so many unusual crafts available. Fight off the temptation and wait until you have done a guided tour with Abdul.
The tour takes 4 hours and is very informative. Abdul knows the city exceptionally well as he does the history of Marrakesh and, indeed, Morocco. We were taken to every important and interesting sight in Marrakesh including the secret garden, around the main mosque and square.
What made the tour particularly interesting was the tour through the craftsman workshops. There was an earthquake in 2023 and many of the workshops were damaged. The craftsmen work in what remains of their workshops creating the most incredible products including metal crafts, wooden crafts and woven crafts.
Abdul has a love of his city and the people living and working there. Tourism is a key source of income helping the city recover from the earthquake and he shows you the heart of the city striving for this not just the normal tourist attractions. He helped guide us on bartering and advising on what a fair price was for items we purchased.
The tour is worth every dharma and you feel like you are saying farewell to a friend when the tour ends.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Susan G","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVAuCOujTU57ZwzhWoSHOcPIw1Xp4jhOFmJzxq79Wz6piW-IOmo=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our family gives the highest possible recommendation to Abdul and Marrakech Guided Tours.

During our time in Morocco, we spent three days with Abdul doing his tours of the old city of Marrakech, the Atlas Mountains, and Essaouira.  Each tour was amazing in its own way.

Abdul grew up in the city of Marrakech, and he knows its every corner.  It was so pleasant as we went through the day to have multiple locals greet him and us.  He took us to a number of fascinating sites that we would have never found without a guide.  For example, we visited a traditional bakery, the underworkings of a Hammam, and co-op of disabled women who make crafts to support themselves.  In addition, we visited most of the "must-see" locations and benefited from Adbul knowing the best places to stop for a meal with a view or a snack.  He was very interested in finding out what WE wanted to see and make sure that he included those things in our day.  The city could be intimidating without a guide, as the spoken and written languages are so different from English.  Abdul is friendly, pleasant, and patient and made this day an eventful one for us.

The Atlas mountains tour gave us the unique opportunity to have a meal in the home of a Berber family, during which Abdul taught our 16-year-old daughter the traditional tea service.  The family was lovely, and the food was fantastic.  My favorite part of the trip was giving small gifts (see my photo) to the local children.  They were adorable.

Essaouira is a beautiful coastal town.  Again, we had an incredible meal with Abdul's connections.  There are many arts and crafts locally made there, and we left with some personalized souvenirs that we treasure still.  There is a WONDERFUL surprise on the way to the town.  I wont spoil it for you, but it made the trip worthwhile in itself.

Our family lives in a small town in South Carolina, USA, but we have traveled to Europe, Asia, Australia, and South America.  I can honestly give Abdul our HIGHEST recommendation for providing great tours, making us feel comfortable and welcomed in Morocco, and ensuring that we saw all of the best sights. Merci beaucoup Abdelhaq et Adil.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"yanik mika","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIwWpFrxTh7IyluAIaYVIb_B3K02RgKlj0raTF2x4Dm3Odh7g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Ce site est très merveilleux je l’ai déjà adapter et je n’ai regretter pas c’est ça que m’a poussé pour encourager les gens de l’utiliser","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"James Dade","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWqiTGKXw6FGRGmCsj4RopHfFZFgtevGjH-YeBFn9m_89EWLWQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"From the first time speaking with Abdel via Whatsapp, I knew I had the correct person to help guide our family through planning an 8 day Morocco adventure. He seamlessly took our ideas and the expressed strengths and weaknesses of our group to steer us towards the perfect adventure for our family of four (2 adults / 2 kids ages 7 and 9). He communicated clearly throughout the planning and prior to arrival. Abdel helped book accommodations that we liked (not forcing us into anything), coordinated private transports, meals, experiences and more throughout our stay which included stops in the Atlas Mountains (Imlil and Ouirgane) and Agafay.

After meeting us on the morning of our arrival in Marrakech, his service only got better. When we struggled through the first tour a bit with jet-lagged children, he offered to do another tour the next day (without asking for anything more). This further enriched our experience by allowing us to rest and reset even though it wasn't scheduled. He taught us about Marrakech and Morocco as a whole and kept our children engaged the entire time. Similarly, Abdel stayed in contact and helpful throughout our trip once we moved on from Marrakech. He even offered to pick up custom ordered loafers which I couldn't get back to retrieve before departing, and he had them delivered to us before our flight out - again - without asking anything for it.

Not only is Morocco Travelogue a well-run professional service, we felt Abdel and those that he coordinated with genuinely cared about us and our trip, and I consider Abdel a friend. Highly recommend!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBJvCbSe68_CY8lcxLp3uwZ&fid=0x0:0xd2bb6f047aa83b72"],"When":"2026-1-12"},{"Name":"Helen Simmons","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXemmPGAkQLTnWN5dOeUBBDZF_N2ueRvuWy7dhC4J_qBdybGq6K=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The BEST thing we have experienced so far in Marrakech. Cannot recommend him more highly.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAboOXp9vUp90EL3K9RHF0C&fid=0x0:0xd2bb6f047aa83b72"],"When":"2026-2-8"},{"Name":"Rainer Schlegel","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXU82Df6wGIvbUpRZPyAbILKhElWM_mR1a8vy3-PVLzOBGQ6PCn=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Sehr empfehlenswerte Souk-Tour durch Marrakesch!

Abdel war ein absolut großartiger Tourguide – kompetent, herzlich und mit einer spürbaren Leidenschaft für seine Stadt. Er hat uns mit viel Hintergrundwissen, Humor und Geduld durch die verwinkelten Gassen der Souks geführt und uns Orte gezeigt, die wir alleine niemals entdeckt hätten.

Dank ihm haben wir nicht nur die Vielfalt und Farbenpracht Marrakeschs erlebt, sondern auch spannende Einblicke in Handwerk, Traditionen und das tägliche Leben bekommen. Besonders angenehm war, dass wir uns jederzeit sicher und gut aufgehoben gefühlt haben.

Je recommande vivement.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBgB8Coj8P3EZNINQK6H0CS&fid=0x0:0xfda5abc61b3402b7"],"When":"2025-12-13"},{"Name":"Olivier Tourniaire","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX6tk8f1O4Q8rEzQIrzHwBQZlyM9rwcmZCGNnI09tRZQzGuIQDx=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Un immense merci à Jawad Mazik, notre guide passionné, et à Tichka, notre incroyable chauffeur de l'agence Marrakech Outdoor Trips, qui ont rendu cette journée exceptionnelle !
Grâce à eux, nous avons vécu une expérience inoubliable : balade à dos de dromadaire près du lac Takerkoust, visite du souk hebdomadaire de la commune de Tahananout, visite d'une coopérative d'huile d'argan, arrêts dans plusieurs villages berbères pour découvrir leur histoire et leurs traditions, puis la découverte splendide de la vallée d'Imlil.
Des paysages magnifiques, des explications claires et enrichissantes, et une ambiance conviviale tout au long de la journée.
Agence recommandé et sans hésitation avec Jawad et Tichka pour vivre une excursion authentique et pleine de découvertes !","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBfIthw3ccYFQZexqdV1I4D&fid=0x0:0xfda5abc61b3402b7"],"When":"2025-9-23"},{"Name":"Guillaume TERRIEN","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUy-8ddAC1qJQ9vMVBpryeWLfkwQBJj298eMrM3urdEZf0iJDak=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nous avons participé à une excursion Les 3 vallées , l'Atlas, et ballade Dromadaire. Déjà un grand merci de nous avoir pris en charge à notre hôtel 🙏.
Ensuite on nous avons eu la chance d'avoir Yasmine et un chauffeur ( désolé j'ai oublié le prénom ....) au TOP !
Tout débute par un arrêt dans la vallée de l'Ourika avec une ballade en Dromadaires en tenue traditionnelle, avec des photos dignes de pro, un thé sous une tente ... Un super moment ... Nous et les enfants avont adoré.
Ensuite , nous reprenons la route vers une coopérative d'Argan dans des maisons Berbères... De nouveau , un thé à la menthe avec un petit déjeuner excellent ... ( Petit pain à tremper dans miel, huile et Nutella Berbère...). Des femmes très accueillantes.
Direction ensuite dans un marché berbère... Une expérience inédite ... Un monde fou ... Très chouette a découvrir .
Ensuite direction les cascades , une belle ballade accessible à tous ... Et pour finir , un déjeuner dans la famille de Yasmine avec couscous , tajine, tarte aux pommes , boisson... Tout était extrêmement bon !!!
Puis retour à notre hôtel...
Franchement, un grand grand merci pour cette journée à Yasmine ( une guide extraordinaire... Tout au long du trajet elle nous a partager sa culture, des explications sur les us et coutumes... toujours accessible , super avec les enfants ... ). Elle a su faire de cette journée notre plus beau moment de nos vacances au Maroc. Et merci beaucoup à notre chauffeur ...
N'hésitez surtout pas à les solliciter ... Leur équipe familiale est TOP !!!
Au Plaisir.
Faustine, Laure, Gwilherm et Guillaume.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICbxdWx6AE&fid=0x0:0xfda5abc61b3402b7"],"When":"2024-7-29"},{"Name":"Brice Perochon","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWFcHHUoIyX5M45tKpNMUEfMwbXTLu2lmps2UR8_S3m2DJCVctJ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Que dire de plus que... GÉNIAL
Nous avons tout simplement adoré notre journée !
Ballade en chameaux, visite d'une coopérative fabricant de l'huile d'Argan, d'un marché Berbère, déjeuner dans un village typique Marocain, découverte de la vallée d’Ourika, thés à la menthe, etc
Un tarif très attractif comprenant notre prise en charge et retour au plus près de notre Riad, un véhicule climatisé moderne, propre et bien équipé, un déjeuner très bon, des visites au top, un chauffeur pro et sympathique mais surtout, notre guide Yasmine FANTASTIQUE, professionnelle, souriante, à l'écoute, aux petits soins, intéressante !
Un grand merci à toi Yasmine, tu as illuminé cette sortie avec tes commentaires, ta culture et ta gentillesse, mes fils étaient contents.
Brice, Simon & Jules.
Les Français de Vendée 85

Superbes photos de la balade en dromadaire, visite et petit-deejeuner dans une cooperative solidaire tenue par des femmes très sympathiques (et qui ne poussent pas à la consommation), belle randonnée vers les cascades et excellentissime repas avec couscous ET tajine dans la maison familiale. Nos recogió en el aeropuerto y nos llevó a lo largo de todo el trayecto por Fez, dónde nos alojamos en  Palais Laarachi con servicio de increíble desayuno,a 200 mts. De la puerta azul dónde hay bares, resto como Fez & Friend muy bueno , hicimos visita guiada por la parte externa de Fez, visitando el palacio de las 7 puertas, coop de cerámica, barrio judío , para luego internarnos en la Medina con el guia  Majin , muy bueno al día siguiente fuimos a Chefchaouen, visitando el pueblo azul y ahí nos esperaba el guia Hazin quien nos descubrió la Menina y la historia del pueblo azul, luego seguimos viaje al desierto pero antes visitamos Ifrane , bosque de cedros azul, interactuamos en una parada donde se encuentra una reserva de monos, y finalmente llegamos a Merzouga (desierto), allí experiencia de las majestuosas dunas y su recorrido en dromedarios, alojandonos en el campamento Berber luxcamp de lo mejor con rica cena, fogón y baile al sonar de los tambores, descubrir el majestuoso cielo limpio y amanecer ,ver el sol con excelente desayuno. Pero acá quiero destacar algo muy importante, durante estos 5 días de compartir con Brahin se formó un intercambio cultural muy rico y tuvo la amabilidad de llevarnos hasta su pueblo Berber Boumalne, en pleno desierto a que conozcamos a su familia, su madre, cuñadas, sobrinas, invitando nos con te y frutos secos, MARAVILLOSO. Gracias Brahin por permitirnos esa visita. I joined their city walking tour with eight other people. The guide's English was clear and accessible, and they were incredibly patient and knowledgeable about Marrakech's history especially regarding niche local customs. My favorite stop was the Bahia Palace.

Having had a subpar experience with a city tour in Fes, I was initially hesitant, but this guide proved to be both professional and honest. Joining group tours in Morocco often feels like a stroke of luck, and ratings are merely a reference. This reminds me of my experience with Amigo Tours in Mexico, despite their high volume of participants and positive reviews on major platforms, they once left us behind at the meeting point and drove off, then flatly refused any refunds or alternatives. My non-absolute conclusion is that the positive reviews for Marrakech Guided Experience feel more authentic and carry more weight. Their credibility is much higher.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Pamela Arcella","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWE3cS1flABwd0xREEPZSHY3-Y-u4ZiXAAmXDheinjCM1W_erXP=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Dal momento che il fornitore mi ha rifiutato la recensione su Get your Guide ci provo qua...prenotato tour del souk di 4 ore con guida italiana...pessimo! Durata 2 ore e mezza, è stata una corsa tra i souk senza nemmeno il tempo di scattare due foto. Ci portava solo nei negozi che diceva lui per farci comprare. Purtroppo non posso recensire direttamente il tour che avevo prenotato ma si chiama "Marrakech: tour guidato a piedi dei coloratissimi souk della medina". Probabilmente è stata la nostra guida ad essere del tutto inadeguata, fatto sta che abbiamo buttato 100 euro per questa cosa. Il fatto che il fornitore abbia rifiutato la recensione mi conferma la poca serietà dell'azienda","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Thea Jianu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX-wPWLjiTL1h1g1VP2N0daIZJpCdLQ7FYpoZ-uIkXuLmgdRu0fog=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Amazing!! We did a street food tour in the evening and the tour was incredible and so informative. We visited 6 stalls around the medina where we tried a variety of foods from olives to soups to traditional pancakes. The tour ended with a nice dinner at a rooftop restaurant which made it very special. Our guide Mo was really knowledgeable, very nice, and polite and very happy to see all of us enjoying the delicious Morrocan food. He was able to answer all my questions and he was very friendly. Mo made the tour extra special. I would 100% recommend the food tour if you love amazing food and good stories!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDt1pncvQE&fid=0x0:0x76110e060bddc4cc"],"When":"2024-2-4"},{"Name":"raghi hakim","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUNiWKCWd0vCnOtQhhV9qchhC2UXprlA2pRqa1bgMqt5lhnS7rF=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I've been on tours around Marrakech many times, but this time it seems like I'm seeing things for the first time, thank to this tour guide who let us my wife and I, discover monuments his way, he tells the history like a storyteller, so helpful and so nice with all his customers.
I recommend him strongly he will make you love Morocco.
Hak.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDN_fuYPA&fid=0x0:0x76110e060bddc4cc"],"When":"2024-1-25"},{"Name":"Ana Lapa","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXwvjgn9v6qq5d4KqwPZmXptQaQ3nQ9LNWWs0Us8INED1TQN3GG=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our guide Abdou was lovely and very very knowledgeable of Moroccan culture and history. He took us to food spots where the locals eat, and we tried the delicious cuisine of Marrakesh while listening to interesting stories about the culture. He picked us up from the Riad and the tour took approximately 3 hours. It was a great way to see for the first time the souks and Jemma el-Fna as this was the first thing we did as soon as we arrive from the airport. I'll definitely choose the Marrakesh Guided Experience food tour.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgICGnvLxZA&fid=0x0:0x76110e060bddc4cc"],"When":"2021-10-30"},{"Name":"Marie Faulkner Lietz","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWKOZUDkjfYTF7qkAWCPA7slbXFXurE7OnTuLKqS5cEB5dS7NxENA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We originally booked a group tour with Marrakech Guided Experiences on Expedia, but due to some delays we missed the original booking time. Mohammed, the owner, offered to take us on a private tour instead. He was incredibly accommodating and made us feel comfortable right away. His knowledge of the Medina and connections with the locals really stood out, making the experience smooth and enjoyable.

We enjoyed the tour so much that we also signed up for his shopping tour. Mohammed is a kind and thoughtful guide, and we’d highly recommend his tours to anyone visiting Marrakech!","Images":null,"When":""}]

Chefchouen (the pearl blue city) is a beautiful city but if you have knee problem goodluck as the nice Riads are up high and they dont have elevators. Climbing 260 steps to get to one is exhausting but the view and sunset are spectacular.
We also went to Rabat, Casablanca and Fez.
Must visit the leather tannery in Fez.
Drove through the winding road on the Atlas mountain.
